patches.new: In quantum mechanics, for a particle without spin, time reversal acts on wavefunctions by complex conjugation, $\psi\to\bar\psi$. Here is why conjugation is the right operation. The plane wave $e^{ikx}$ has momentum $p=k$. Its conjugate $e^{-ikx}$ has momentum $-k$, so conjugation reverses the momentum. More generally, $\hat p=-i\,\dd/\dd x$ contains an explicit $i$. Therefore $\overline{\hat p\psi}=\overline{-i\psi'}=i\bar\psi'=-\hat p\bar\psi$, while multiplication by $x$ is unchanged by conjugation. Conjugation thus keeps $x$ and flips $p$, exactly as the backward film does.
